description_expanded: Overview5.0(14 reviews)SEACREST – Front Porch Sitting Private Pool & Spa | Sleeps 10 DESCRIPTION Welcome to Front Porch Sitting, a beautiful beach home that promises relaxation and fun. Located on a quiet, family-friendly street just a block from the beach, this charming getaway is perfect for families or friends looking to enjoy a peaceful retreat near the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast. Relax on the spacious front porch or enjoy the expansive back deck, featuring a private pool and spa. With two master bedrooms, a fun bunk room, and ample space for everyone, Front Porch Sitting is designed with comfort in mind. The home is ideally located near restaurants, shopping, and the recreational activities of Alys, Rosemary, and Seacrest beaches. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Enjoy outdoor living at its finest with a relaxing front porch and large back deck. Cool off in the private pool and spa, perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. Beach access is just a short walk away, making it easy to enjoy the sand and surf. HOME FEATURES 3 bedrooms | 2 bathrooms | Sleeps 10 2 master bedrooms with king-sized plush mattresses Bunk room with 2 twin beds and 1 full-sized plush mattress Living room with pull-out queen mattress Private pool (heating available for an additional fee) and spa Fully equipped kitchen and dining area Kid-friendly features, including a small table and chairs and beach toys DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Close to restaurants, shopping, and recreational activities in Alys, Rosemary, and Seacrest Beach Just a block to the private beach for easy access to the Emerald Coast Family-friendly home with kid-sized furniture and beach toys WHY STAY HERE?
